title: InterPilot: Exploring the Design Space of AI-assisted Job Interview Support for HR Professionals
summary: Recruitment interviews are cognitively demanding interactions in which interviewers must simultaneously listen, evaluate candidates, take notes, and formulate follow-up questions. To better understand these challenges, we conducted a formative study with eight HR professionals, from which we derived key design goals for real-time AI support. Guided by these insights, we developed InterPilot, a prototype system that augments interviews through intelligent note-taking and post-interview summary, adaptive question generation, and real-time skill-evidence mapping. We evaluated the system with another seven HR professionals in mock interviews using a within-subjects design.
